items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: Her name was, oh, she was Dad James' wife... Tilly Johnson, Tilly Johnson. She was, I think, one of the, you know, another, what I call, coon shouter, too, you know.

ctx.x: Well, who were some of the singers around town that were prominent on the order of Ma Rainey? You mean here in New Orleans? In New Orleans, did you hear her?

Her name was, oh, she was Dad James' wife. Dad James was a sort of a producer and a comedian that gave shows around. Tilly Johnson, Tilly Johnson. She was, I think, one of the, you know, another, what I call, coon shouter, too, you know.
Ann Cook singing when you were coming out?
